summary: Addressing class imbalance through SMOTE and class weighting improved model quality. ROC-AUC improved from 0.8473 (baseline) to 0.8482 (Class Weights), a gain of 0.0009. F1-score also improved, indicating better performance on the minority class. Class weighting was the most effective approach for this dataset.
methodological_choices: Used Logistic Regression as the base model. Preprocessing: dropped rows with missing values, label-encoded categorical variables, standardized numerical features. Train-test split: 80-20 with stratification. Compared three approaches: (1) Baseline without imbalance handling, (2) SMOTE oversampling applied only to training set, (3) Class weight balancing. Evaluated using ROC-AUC and F1-score as primary metrics (ROC-AUC selected for final comparison). Tested on 9045 test samples with original class imbalance ratio of 0.315.
